content.text: {"headline":"Recommend no action (P0): the blended service level is predicted at 81.2% for 14:00-17:45, above the 80% target, at no extra cost.","why":"The surge in general calls traces to the 10:15 home-loan SMS (MKT-2026-825). Loan enquiries are running at 2.02x normal, and service level fell to 41.3% this morning. Handle time and staffing are close to plan. With no changes, the window is forecast at 81.2% overall, with payments at 89.0% and general at 74.9%, a 4.0% abandon rate and 84.1% for the rest of the day. That makes it the cheapest plan that meets target and follows policy. General on its own stays below 80% under this plan.","trade_offs":["P1 (no-cost agent moves plus callback) lifts general only slightly, to 75.4%. It lowers the blended figure to 80.6% and takes payments down to 87.0%, so it adds disruption for no overall gain.","P4 (staffing only, ₹75) brings general to 76.0% and abandons to 3.8%. Payments drops to 87.3% and the blended figure is 81.1%, essentially the same as doing nothing.","P2 (₹156) and P3 (₹231) are the only plans that get general above 80%, at 81.6% and 81.5%. Both rely on an IVR outage message for loan enquiries, which breaks CX-01 because there is no confirmed outage or incident; the batch-job issue was unrelated and has already been fixed.","None of the plans puts payments at real risk; it stays at 87% or above throughout."],"watch":"Watch general-queue service level and abandons, especially for loan_enquiry. General is forecast at 74.9%, so if it falls further, or a second campaign wave arrives, switch to P4's agent moves. No escalation is needed."}
